features.description: Pure projection from the loaded supervisors stream into the live-agents view shape the Work board renders. Reads the supervisors stream and returns a list of live-agent entries each carrying a stable id, a display name, a busy-or-idle status, the current plan/feature focus, and a last-updated stamp. Mirrors the existing legacy-precedence rule: derive from the stream only when the stream is present; never clobber a meaningful static value when the stream is absent; a present stream takes precedence. Output carries no secret shapes. Pure and read-only — no on-disk writes.
steps: Add the projection helper alongside the existing plans-and-inbox projection
Map each supervisors-stream entry to the live-agents view shape (id, name, status, current focus, updated stamp)
Apply legacy-precedence: present stream wins; absent stream leaves a meaningful static value intact
Add unit coverage for present, empty, and partial-entry streams plus the no-secret-shape assertion
features.acceptance: A pure projection converts a loaded supervisors stream into the live-agents view shape and is covered for present, empty, and partial-entry inputs, with a present stream taking precedence and an absent stream leaving a meaningful static value intact; the projected output carries no secret shapes.

features.description: Wire the new projection into the existing browser load path so a single load both adapts canonical state and lights up the live-agents lane. The projection runs at the same point the plans-and-inbox projection already runs, reads only the already-loaded supervisors stream, and writes no on-disk state. The Work board's live-agents lane renders from the projected output.
steps: Invoke the new projection from the same load step as the plans-and-inbox projection
Confirm the live-agents lane in the Work board renders from the projected output
Confirm the load path performs no on-disk write
features.acceptance: The new projection runs inside the existing browser load path alongside the plans-and-inbox projection, the Work board live-agents lane renders from its output, and the load path performs no on-disk write.

features.description: End-to-end honesty: prove a registered active supervisor surfaces as a live agent rather than via a hand-built fixture. The producer already sources the supervisors stream from the active-supervisor registry. A projection test whose input shape is bound to the producer stream entry contract (guarded so producer-shape drift fails the test) asserts that a registered active supervisor renders as one live agent with a non-zero running count through the real load-and-project path. Distinguishes nothing-running (honest zero) from running-but-not-surfaced (the bug this plan fixes).
steps: Capture a supervisors-stream fixture whose shape is bound to the producer stream entry contract
Add a drift guard so a change to the producer entry shape fails this test
Assert a registered active supervisor renders as one live agent with a non-zero running count through the real load-and-project path
Assert the honest-zero case (empty stream) renders zero live agents
features.acceptance: A projection test whose input is bound to the producer stream entry contract (with a drift guard) shows a registered active supervisor rendering as one live agent with a non-zero running count through the real load-and-project path, while an empty stream renders an honest zero.
